# rind on `x86-host-b-zen5`: AMD Ryzen 7 255 w/ Radeon 780M Graphics

3 runs of rind's own `admin/bench-report run` at [`d6ca9a75`](https://github.com/moq-dev/rind/commit/d6ca9a756d3d1e71489e61e44c04f33c3c893589), each pinned to one core. Every time is the median of the runs' criterion estimates (`x86-host-b-zen5.json`, schema 1, with each run's estimate in `runs_ns`); [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) lists every run, [facts.txt](facts.txt) the hardware and load, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) how the host was run and what to read into the numbers.

- CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 255 w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (x86_64, 16 logical CPUs)
- OS: Oracle Linux Server 10.1 (Linux 6.12.0-202.76.4.2.el10uek.x86_64)
- Toolchain: rustc 1.98.1 (48a229cea 2026-09-01)
- OpenSSL linked: OpenSSL 3.5.8 25 Aug 2026 (Library: OpenSSL 3.5.8 25 Aug 2026)
- CPU features rind reads (rind-cpuid): adx, aes, vaes, pclmulqdq, vpclmulqdq, bmi1, bmi2, movbe, popcnt, ssse3, sse4.1, avx, avx2, avx512f, avx512dq, avx512ifma, avx512bw, avx512vl, avx512vbmi, avx512vbmi2, sha; absent: intel, sha512
- Libraries refused for missing CPU features: none
- Noisy (bench-report's flag, any run): no
